name: ui-motion
description: High-taste UI motion skills: kinetic typography heroes, scroll-linked blur manifesto sections, and a thermal shader field you smear with a finger.

interface.shortDescription: Kinetic type heroes, scroll-blur manifestos, and a finger-smeared thermal field.
interface.longDescription: Three reusable UI motion skills: an electric inflated-type hero and a quiet Lenis/GSAP blur-to-sharp manifesto from the Zine homepage, and Clicker's thermal finger trail, a WebGL heat-camera field you drag like wet paint.
